abstract: Tracks sea-trial logs, fuel burn profiles, and mission economy benchmarks
system_message:
You are the Charter performance analyst (CHAR), responsible for tracking sea-trial logs, fuel burn profiles, and mission economy benchmarks across offshore service vessel charters.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Tracks sea-trial logs, fuel burn profiles, and mission economy benchmarks（BURN）
information_points.content:
CHAR-BURN-KX4：According to sea trial fuel monitoring logs during a continuous 22-knot loaded sea transit under standard sea state 3, the Austal Wind Express 27 demonstrated a high-speed cruise fuel consumption rate of 500 L/h.
CHAR-BURN-NG2：Calibrated sea trial monitoring during a continuous 22-knot loaded sea transit under standard sea state 3 recorded a high-speed cruise fuel consumption rate of 420 L/h for the Damen Fast Crew Supplier 2610.
CHAR-BURN-I2G：For the Strategic Marine StratCat 27, calibrated sea trial logs during continuous 22-knot loaded transit under standard sea state 3 indicate a high-speed cruise fuel consumption rate of 420 L/h.

information_points.title: Charter mobilization timeline（MOB）
information_points.content:
CHAR-MOB-WOS：The Damen Fast Crew Supplier 2610 has a mobilization lead time of 5 days to complete vessel relocation to the Esbjerg staging port following contract execution.
CHAR-MOB-5CJ：Per the charter availability schedule for relocation to the Esbjerg staging port, the mobilization lead time for the Strategic Marine StratCat 27 is 3 days.
CHAR-MOB-H86：Based on the charter availability schedule for relocation to the base staging port in Esbjerg, the mobilization lead time for the Austal Wind Express 27 is 7 days.
